topic.label: UI and Front-End Development
topic.desc: Building what people see in a browser: HTML, CSS and layout, components and frameworks, accessibility, browser testing and building websites.

concepts.label: Accessibility
concepts.desc: Making interfaces usable by everyone: WCAG, keyboard access, screen readers, contrast and focus.

concepts.label: Components and Frameworks
concepts.desc: UI components, state in the browser, and frameworks such as React, Vue and Svelte.

concepts.label: HTML, CSS and Layout
concepts.desc: Page structure and styling: semantic HTML, CSS, flexbox and grid layout, responsive design and theming.

concepts.label: Browser Testing
concepts.desc: Testing web front ends in real browsers: end-to-end tests, visual checks and console errors.

concepts.label: Websites and Web Apps
concepts.desc: Building a website or web app end to end: pages, content, routing, build tools, performance and where it is deployed.

skills.label: Accessibility Auditor
skills.desc: Audits a page against WCAG 2.1 AA and lists each failure with its fix.

skills.label: Component Designer
skills.desc: Designs a reusable UI component with its props, states and events.

skills.label: Framework Selector
skills.desc: Compares front-end frameworks for a project by size, ecosystem and rendering model.

skills.label: CSS Debugger
skills.desc: Finds why an element is positioned or styled wrongly and gives the minimal CSS fix.

skills.label: Responsive Layout Builder
skills.desc: Builds a responsive page layout in HTML and CSS that works from phone to desktop width.

skills.label: Console Error Triage
skills.desc: Triages browser console and network errors on a page and names the cause.

skills.label: End-to-End Test Writer
skills.desc: Writes end-to-end browser tests for a user flow with assertions on what the user sees.

skills.label: Web Performance Auditor
skills.desc: Audits a website's load performance and lists the largest wins.

skills.label: Website Builder
skills.desc: Plans and builds a website: pages, navigation, content, build tooling and deploy target.

mcp.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
mcp.desc: Chrome DevTools MCP server: inspect a live Chrome page, console, network requests, performance traces and front-end debugging.

mcp.name: Playwright MCP
mcp.desc: Microsoft Playwright MCP server: drive a browser through accessibility snapshots, navigate pages, click, fill forms and test web front ends.
